    rows = [set() for _ in range(9)]
    cols = [set() for _ in range(9)]
    boxes = [set() for _ in range(9)]
    empties = []

        for j in range(9):

                empties.append((i, j))
            else:
                v = board[i][j]
                rows[i].add(v)
                cols[j].add(v)
                boxes[(i // 3) * 3 + j // 3].add(v)
    def back(k):
        if k == len(empties):
            return True

        b = (i // 3) * 3 + j // 3
        for v in '123456789':
            if v in rows[i] or v in cols[j] or v in boxes[b]:
                continue
            board[i][j] = v
            rows[i].add(v); cols[j].add(v); boxes[b].add(v)
            if back(k + 1):
                return True
            board[i][j] = '.'
            rows[i].remove(v); cols[j].remove(v); boxes[b].remove(v)
        return False
    back(0)
    return board
